correctness.rationale: Exact hypersurface gradient is diagonal cofactors. On det=0, adjugate rank-one argument proves singular support is rank<=n-2; invertible Schur block yields detA*(uv+w^2) and intrinsic Jacobian ideal (u,v,w^2). Change of kernel frame and O(1) trivialization gives transition detG/lambda and nilradical detK tensor O(-1). Frobenius kernel Gauss factor is surjective onto diagonal dual space. This symbolic argument applies to all n>=4; exact exhaustive GF2 checks for n=4,5 corroborate and do not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: For an intrinsic universal algebraic-geometric discriminant in characteristic two, a globally determined infinitesimal nilpotent line on a positive-dimensional smooth corank-two stratum is materially stronger than knowing reduced rank support. The canonical twist can enter intersection and specialization computations and exposes a modular failure of the classical symmetric-determinant dual geometry. It is not a finite experiment, arbitrary subfamily or mere rank count. No global assertion over deeper corank is made.
